endpoints.description: Fetch records from a DOL dataset (e.g. OSHA inspections, enforcement)
List datasets/fields available for an agency

limits.notes: DOL Data Portal API requires a registered API key (X-API-KEY header). Verify current host/path (apiprod.dol.gov v4) and per-key rate limits against the live data portal docs — DOL has migrated API versions repeatedly.

llmDocs.summary: Department of Labor datasets including OSHA enforcement/inspections, wage and hour (WHD) violations, MSHA mine safety, and EBSA. Unified data portal API keyed by agency + dataset.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Authenticate with X-API-KEY header. Discover datasets via the metadata endpoint for an agency, then query /get/{agency}/{dataset}/json with filter, fields, limit, and offset params. OSHA enforcement is under the 'enforcement' agency grouping.

exampleQueries.intent: Recent OSHA inspections (shape varies by dataset)

gotchas: Dataset and field names are not stable across the portal; always pull metadata first.
DOL has changed API host/version several times — confirm apiprod.dol.gov/v4 is current before building.
Key goes in the X-API-KEY header, not a query param.

compliance.redistributionNotes: Public domain US government data. Enforcement records are case-level public records.
